name: Laadan
overview: Laadan is identified in Scripture as a descendant of Ephraim and a Levite, also known by the name Libni, highlighting a dual identity within the tribe of Levi as recorded in 1 Chronicles 23:7. The genealogical record emphasizes the leadership within Laadan's family, naming his sons Jehiel, Zetham, and Joel as chief figures (1 Chronicles 23:8). Additionally, the passage notes the familial connections through Shimei and his sons, underscoring the structured and God-ordained organization of the Levite families for service (1 Chronicles 23:9). This brief but specific mention affirms the continuity of God's covenant people through appointed leaders from the tribe of Levi.
